description: Run the Foundry action helix_foundry_prepare_operation prepared: the same operation, target and payload, with its confirmation. A confirmation runs once, and the action is never retried. A client that can ask the person asks them first, and runs it only on their yes.
name: helix_foundry_execute_operation

result.description: Untrusted result: what the operation made or changed: an ontology, sync, generation, version, load, document (with its reads), document set, review decision, the sample's data (add_sample_data: its connector, sync, document set and documents), dashboard, workflow, a workflow's run (run_workflow), or the Assistant's runtime or helper; a delete_dashboard or delete_workflow gives {deleted: true} with its dashboard_id or workflow_id.

title: Run a prepared Foundry action
